## Samsung Foundry Adds AI Chip Power IP to Platform to Compete for Advanced AI Design Wins

Samsung Foundry adding AI-specific power IP is a direct competitive challenge in the race for AI chip design wins — a negative read for any foundry peer's exclusivity narrative in advanced AI process nodes, and relevant for portfolio names evaluating supply diversification.

- Samsung Electronics is adding new AI chip power intellectual property to its foundry service offering.
- The capability addition is explicitly targeted at attracting AI chip customers to Samsung Foundry.
- Represents a direct competitive move against leading foundry alternatives in the AI chip tape-out market.
- No specific process node, customer names, or IP licensing terms are cited in the headline.
